comparator_concordance.note: The comparator engine's output on every chromosome of the four population datasets, scored against Ensembl VEP 116.2's archived output with the same comparator, cache and reference FASTA as the vep-rs tables; a variant is one VCF record, a tuple one output row reduced to its Location, Allele, Feature, Feature_type and Consequence set; F1 pools by summed counts. The adjusted figure sets aside the same documented classes as for vep-rs; where the engine produces none of their shapes it equals the raw one. The engine's residual (open rows) is reported, not gated.

methodology_note: Five independent machines per chromosome per architecture, each a fresh instance booting a stock image and copying the shard, the caches and the reference to its local NVMe, running one discarded warmup whose output is flushed and deleted and then the timed run, --fork 16 --buffer_size 5000, output to the local NVMe; cell quantiles by the Weibull estimator (R type 6); a dataset's figure is the sum of its per-chromosome medians. The sites-only canonical inputs (INFO retained) are the ones the whole-genome concordance scored.
scope: Whole-genome wall time of the released vep-rs version and of the comparator engine on both architectures, the Ensembl VEP 116.2 reference run's wall time on the same inputs, and the comparator engine's whole-genome concordance; the released version's own whole-genome concordance is in its release record.
